ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Pictures and stories: Which sentence describes a feeling? (1 mark)
   A. She was very happy to hear from him.
   B. The computer was on.
   C. He clicked Send.
   D. The message travelled.

2. What is the contraction of 'they are'? (1 mark)
   A. theyr'e
   B. thay're
   C. they're
   D. they'er

3. Quantifiers: Choose the correct sentence. (1 mark)
   A. How many water do you drink?
   B. How many waters do you drink?
   C. How much water do you drink?
   D. How much waters do you drink?

4. Which preposition completes: 'I am afraid ____ thieves.'? (1 mark)
   A. at
   B. of
   C. to
   D. in

5. What is the best way to practise a tongue twister? (1 mark)
   A. Read it silently only
   B. Say it slowly first, then faster
   C. Whisper it once
   D. Say it as fast as you can straight away

6. Which quantifier goes with a countable plural noun in a question? (1 mark)
   A. a little
   B. less
   C. many
   D. much

7. Articles: Choose the correct sentence. (1 mark)
   A. She has an uncle.
   B. She has the an uncle.
   C. She has uncle an.
   D. She has a uncle.

8. How should the initials of Peter Otieno Juma be written? (1 mark)
   A. p, o, Juma
   B. p.o.juma
   C. P. O. Juma
   D. P O Juma,

9. Which month is written correctly? (1 mark)
   A. Septembar
   B. Septmber
   C. Septembre
   D. September

10. What is the contraction of 'cannot'? (1 mark)
   A. cann't
   B. ca'nt
   C. can't
   D. cant

11. What are data bundles? (1 mark)
   A. Bundles of firewood
   B. An amount of internet you buy for a phone or computer
   C. A kind of laptop
   D. Sheets of paper

12. What is an inference? (1 mark)
   A. Something not stated directly that you work out from clues
   B. A spelling mistake
   C. The title of a passage
   D. A word from the text copied exactly

13. If you face the rising sun, north is on your (1 mark)
   A. back
   B. left
   C. front
   D. right

14. Which is a simile? (1 mark)
   A. The goat ran quickly.
   B. The goat ran like the wind.
   C. The goat is a runner.
   D. The goat was fast.

15. What is a graded reader? (1 mark)
   A. A book written at a level of difficulty suited to certain readers
   B. A dictionary
   C. A newspaper advert
   D. A test paper

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write four sentences about your morning: two with have or has and two with had. (4 marks)

17. Write four descriptive sentences about your classroom. (4 marks)

18. Write two minimal pairs for /l/ and /r/. (2 marks)

19. Give a memory trick for spelling 'necessary' or 'separate'. (2 marks)

20. Choose the correct word in each: (a) I (know / no) the answer. (b) They put (their / there) bags (their / there). (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — She was very happy to hear from him.
   Was very happy tells a feeling.

2. C — they're
   The apostrophe replaces the a in 'are'.

3. C — How much water do you drink?
   Water is uncountable.

4. B — of
   We say 'afraid of'.

5. B — Say it slowly first, then faster
   Start slowly to get the sounds right, then speed up.

6. C — many
   How many books?

7. A — She has an uncle.
   Uncle starts with a vowel sound, so we use an.

8. C — P. O. Juma
   Capital initials each followed by a full stop.

9. D — September
   September is spelt with a capital S and the ending -ber.

10. C — can't
   'Cannot' becomes 'can't'.

11. B — An amount of internet you buy for a phone or computer
   Data bundles are bought to use the internet.

12. A — Something not stated directly that you work out from clues
   Inferential questions need you to use clues.

13. B — left
   The sun rises in the east. When you face east, north is on your left.

14. B — The goat ran like the wind.
   A simile compares using like or as.

15. A — A book written at a level of difficulty suited to certain readers
   Graded readers are written at different reading levels.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: I have brushed my teeth. She has swept the floor. We had eaten before we left. He had washed before school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Any four correct descriptive sentences with capitals and full stops.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: light, right and load, road.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: 'Necessary' has one collar (c) and two sleeves (ss); 'separate' has 'a rat' in it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a trick and 1 for a correct explanation.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: (a) know (b) their, there
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct choice.
